McuPosSnapshot.description: Snapshot of the position tracker values written by mcu_0160_08009160 each update. The offsets refer to the tracker block passed to that function.

fields.name: speed_est
fields.description: Speed or position-derivative estimate: the tracker field at +0x70, or a product of a 16-bit field at +0x38 and a step count (probably a speed estimate).

fields.name: filtered
fields.description: Six-sample moving average of the tracker field at +0x98 (mcu_moving_average6_update).

fields.name: raw
fields.description: Copy of the tracker field at +0x98, the input of the moving average.

fields.name: prev_5c
fields.description: Value of the tracker field at +0x5C taken before this update (the previous sector value).

fields.name: prev_60
fields.description: Value of the tracker field at +0x60 taken before this update.

McuPiCtrl.description: PI controller block of the drive loop (partly decoded). The gain fields are written by mcu_gain_triple_q15_from_float, the limits by mcu_pid_set_limits. Offsets from the decompiled accesses; the integrator and output fields are not decoded.

fields.name: q15_a
fields.description: First Q15 value of the gain triple (limit from the first float argument).

fields.name: q15_b
fields.description: Second Q15 value of the gain triple (second argument times the scale).

fields.name: q15_c
fields.description: Third Q15 value of the gain triple (third argument times the scale).

fields.name: q15_a_copy
fields.description: Copy of q15_a written at the same time, probably the value used by the loop.

fields.name: q15_b_copy
fields.description: Copy of q15_b written at the same time.

fields.name: q15_c_copy
fields.description: Copy of q15_c written at the same time.

fields.name: out_ptr
fields.description: Pointer to the 32-bit output word. mcu_pid_set_limits clamps the value stored there to the limits.

fields.name: limit_lo
fields.description: Lower output limit, the first argument of mcu_pid_set_limits.

fields.name: limit_hi
fields.description: Upper output limit, the second argument of mcu_pid_set_limits.

fields.name: scale_f32
fields.description: Float scale read by mcu_gain_triple_q15_from_float (it is converted from float).

fields.name: flag_30
fields.description: Flag at 0x20000898 (offset 0x30). Cleared to 0 by the drive cycle and the drive state routine. Probably a reset request for the integrator.

fields.name: enabled
fields.description: Enable byte (offset 0x3E) tested by mcu_pid_set_limits: when non-zero the limits are applied to the output word at once.

McuThreshDebounce12.description: Build 12b threshold debounce object initialised by mcu_threshold_debounce_init_v12b. The field offsets come from the init routine; the meaning of the counters is probable.

fields.name: lo_q15
fields.description: Lower threshold in Q15, the first argument of the init (from DAT_200003E2 or DAT_200003E0).

fields.name: hi_q15
fields.description: Upper threshold in Q15, the second argument of the init (from DAT_200003E4 or DAT_200003E2).

fields.name: mode
fields.description: Sixth argument of the init (value 2 in every call here). Probably a sample count or mode.

fields.name: cnt_a
fields.description: Debounce counter, cleared by the init.

fields.name: cnt_b
fields.description: Second debounce counter, cleared by the init.

fields.name: limit_a
fields.description: Debounce limit passed as the fourth argument (100 in every call here).

fields.name: limit_b
fields.description: Second debounce limit passed as the fifth argument (100 in every call here).

fields.name: state_a
fields.description: State byte, cleared by the init. Probably the current trip state.

fields.name: flag_a
fields.description: Flag byte, cleared by the init.

fields.name: state_b
fields.description: Second state byte, cleared by the init.

fields.name: flag_b
fields.description: Second flag byte, cleared by the init.
